column1: # System units a host must have enabled, by role (decisions/0008). `dram apply` enables
# the missing ones (timers with --now); `dram doctor` reports drift. User units belong to
# Home Manager, not here. Conditional units stay with their script: NetworkManager
# (system/network-setup.sh: it must switch networkd + iwd off in the same step), iwd (maintenance.sh,
# only with a Wi-Fi device), docker (opt-in, decisions/0015), the WSL clone's own
# A role column is a role, a pseudo-role (base: every host; metal: every host on its own
# hardware; wsl: every WSL clone, decisions/0021), "!role" (every host WITHOUT it), or
# several joined by "," that must all hold ("metal,!desktop": metal hosts without desktop).

column3: remote access (harden.sh makes it keys-only; in WSL wsl-setup.sh keeps it on 127.0.0.1:2222 for VSCodium)
the default-deny firewall (system/nftables.conf); WSL: Windows' and the Hyper-V firewall
wired networking on headless hosts (desktops and laptops: NetworkManager; WSL: Windows')
DNS (DNS-over-TLS opportunistic, harden.sh); WSL generates resolv.conf, resolved stays masked
clock (a WSL VM keeps Windows' time)
weekly TRIM on SSDs (in WSL: freed blocks back to the sparse VHDX)
smart-card access for the YubiKeys' PIV (age-plugin-yubikey, ykman piv; docs/security/identity/yubikeys.md)
